# Ohio Precision Fabrication
Ohio Precision Fabrication is a family-owned metal fabrication shop in Dayton, Ohio. We cut, bend, and weld steel and aluminum parts for local manufacturers. Our team of 18 employees runs two shifts. We are a manufacturing company serving the Midwest since 1998.

pages.title: About | Ohio Precision Fabrication
pages.markdown: Founded in 1998 in Dayton, Ohio, Ohio Precision Fabrication has grown to 18 employees. We specialize in precision sheet metal fabrication for US manufacturers.
